subject: Charter Study Final Report Planning
overview: The subcommittee met to determine the structure and drafting responsibilities for the final report. Members assigned specific charter articles to individuals for summary and established a timeline for the report's completion.

items.title: Review of municipal report models
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed reports from Somerville and Framingham to identify structural elements and visual formats suitable for the Medford report.

items.title: Proposed report structure
items.summary: Members agreed on a structure including a member list, introductory letter, executive summary, policy recommendations, the draft charter, and an appendix.

items.title: Policy recommendations and reasoning
items.summary: The subcommittee decided to highlight major policy changes, such as ward representation and term limits, while providing the rationale for decisions that involved split votes.

items.title: Community engagement documentation
items.summary: The committee agreed to include a dedicated section detailing the influence of public surveys and listening sessions on their drafting process.

items.title: Drafting assignments and timeline
items.summary: Members divided drafting tasks by charter article and set a deadline of July 22 for the initial components to be ready for review.
